reason: In pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:116-121, Check immediately returns Allowed: false on a permDenialCache hit, whereas pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:123-136 only short-circuits permCache hits when allowed is true so denials fall through to the database. Because pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:153-155 stores DB denials in permDenialCache for shortCacheTTL (30s, configured at pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:85) with no invalidation in pkg/services/authz/rbac/cache.go, any permission granted afterward for that request is blocked until the cache TTL expires.
